name.en: SD Sangokuden 042 True Shouretsu-tei Dragon Armor Liu Bei Gundam Ryukiho/Matoro

brands.ja: SD ガンダム BB戦士

description.ja: • 劉備ガンダムの最終形態。
• 龍装 劉備ガンダムと龍輝宝が合体し「翔烈帝　龍装　劉備ガンダム」へ。
description.en: • Dragon armor Liu Bei Gundam and Ryuukibao are combined to become "Shoretei Dragon Armor Liu Bei Gundam".

description.ja: • 龍輝宝と的盧が合体し「的盧合体龍輝宝」へ。
description.en: • Ryukiho and Matoro combine to become "Matoro combined Ryukiho".

description.ja: • さらに、龍輝宝は分散して張飛、関羽、趙雲、馬超、黄忠の鎧の一部として装着可能。
description.en: • In addition, Longhuibao can be dispersed and worn as part of the armor of Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao, and Huang Zhong.

description.ja: • 新設定の武器が３種付属。

description.en: Molded product x 10, Seal x 1, Lead wire x 1, Instruction manual included
